name: Animated Gems
summary:
Animated Gems is a spatial exhibition, created exclusively for  immersive environments. Step into an immersive environment where art, technology, and spatial design merge into one. Move through the exhibition at your own pace, discover unique pieces presented in three-dimensional space, and explore the craftsmanship and materials behind each work on display.
Full access to the exhibition is available through a monthly auto-renewing subscription.
Welcome to Animated Gems.
